subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvam operações com números inteiros.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo adição e subtração de números inteiros
components.description_en: Solve problems involving addition and subtraction of integers
components.cc_component_description: Represent addition and subtraction of rational numbers on a number line

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo multiplicação e divisão de números inteiros
components.description_en: Solve problems involving multiplication and division of integers
components.cc_component_description: Use addition and subtraction within 1,000 and multiplication and division within 100 to solve two step real- world problems

components.description_pt: Construir problemas cuja solução exija operações com números inteiros
components.description_en: Construct problems whose solutions require operations with integers
components.cc_component_description: Solve multi-step real-world problems using the four operations

components.description_pt: Aplicar as regras de sinais ao realizar operações com números inteiros
components.description_en: Apply the rules of signs when performing operations with integers
components.cc_component_description: Understand the rules for multiplying signed numbers

cc_matches.description: Understand that multiplication is extended from fractions to rational numbers by requiring that operations continue to satisfy the properties of operations, particularly the distributive property, leading to products such as (-1)(-1) = 1 and the rules for multiplying signed numbers. Interpret products of rational numbers by describing real-world contexts.

Solve two-step word problems using the four operations. Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity. Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies including rounding.
Apply and extend previous understandings of addition and subtraction to add and subtract rational numbers; represent addition and subtraction on a horizontal or vertical number line diagram.

Solve multistep word problems posed with whole numbers and having whole-number answers using the four operations, including problems in which remainders must be interpreted. Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity. Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies including rounding.
